papers.title: Network-Based Brain Stimulation: Targeting the Frontoparietal Network for Cognitive Rehabilitation After Stroke Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.reason: A human clinical meta-analysis of frontoparietal network stimulation for cognitive rehabilitation after stroke is relevant to neural mechanisms and intervention targets for executive control, though not a computational model.

papers.title: Signatures of Performance Monitoring in Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder and At-risk Groups: Midfrontal Theta Predicts Divergent Behavioral Adaptation.
papers.reason: This directly studies midfrontal theta and behavioral adaptation in performance monitoring, a core cognitive control mechanism with clear relevance for computational models of executive function.

papers.title: Predictive stability code: Trial-by-trial conflict expectations tune task representations via proactive and reactive spatio-temporo-spectral dynamics
papers.reason: The paper combines trial-by-trial Bayesian conflict-expectancy modelling with EEG representational analyses to explain proactive and reactive cognitive control mechanisms.

papers.title: Toward Closed-Loop Cognitive Modulation in Alzheimer's Disease: BCI-Relevant Evidence and a Translational Roadmap.
papers.reason: This review is relevant to multimodal cognitive-state sensing and adaptive intervention in AD and MCI, but it is broader than executive-function modelling or diagnostic task-based assessment.
